method: Condensed React checklist; root/Remotion lint and typecheck. Narrow existing lesson-key conditions show only the communication-explain check context and illustration before selection.

checks.keys: Stable language/beat IDs for Composition and Series.Sequence.

checks.accessibility: Bilingual lesson asset alt/caption, optional playback and actual shipped WebVTT. Video viewing is optional.

Feedback, takeaway and audio still use revealSummary; no changed save/progress behavior.
